name: Password Recovery Success
summary: An anonymous user starts from password sign-in, requests recovery for an email address, proves possession of that email with a six-digit code, establishes a new password, and returns to password sign-in.
finalOutcome: The recovery code has been successfully verified and consumed, the password credential has been replaced, and the anonymous user can sign in with the new password.

sourceReferences.note: Six-digit recovery code generation, verification, consumption, and final password reset behavior.
Behavior-first reconciliation of the six-digit password recovery flow.
